QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Who's the Boss?
QuestInfo.1: Leon believes you've found the Assassins Guild hideout. It's possible they've got Il Capo hidden away. They might even have evidence of the Heaven Empire's plot! You and Leon headed into the Sospetto Forest to find out.
QuestInfo.2: Leon believes you've found the Assassins Guild hideout. It's possible they've got Il Capo hidden away. They might even have evidence of the Heaven Empire's plot! You and Leon headed into the Sospetto Forest to find out, and ran into Il Capo himself, the man named Canis! After you beat him, you found an envelope...

0.0: Wait! If there are so many of them around here, maybe they're all hiding out here somewhere. They might be hiding Il Capo even... Maybe we'll find out more about what the Heaven Empire is plotting... I'll look around here!\r\n\rCan you go further inside?

yes.0: Take Il Capo down if you run into him and look for any clues to the Heaven Empire conspiracy! Talk to me when you find anything from taking out the boss.

no.0: Are you giving up? I think we're super close to uncovering the Heaven Empire's plot!

1.msg: Yeah, and I found this envelope!

2.msg: Really? I wonder what's inside.\r\nI'll check it out!

item.0: Get rid of Il Capo when you find him, and look for any clues about the Heaven Empire's plot!
